note_title: 问题1：求 S_N 的极限
summary_en: This note studies the limit and asymptotic expansion of the sequence \(S_N=\frac{1}{N^2}\sum_{n\le N} n\log n-\frac12\log N\). It presents several approaches, including Riemann-sum arguments, integral estimates for sums, and the Euler-Maclaurin formula, yielding the limit \(-\frac14\) and sharper error terms.

problems.statement_en: Let \(S_N:=\log\left(\sqrt[N^2]{\prod_{n\leq N}n^n}\right)-\log(\sqrt{N})\). Find the limit of \(S_N\). Equivalently, \(S_N=\frac{1}{N^2}\sum_{n\leq N} n\log(n)-\frac{1}{2}\log(N)\).
problems.statement_zh:
令$$S_N:=\log\left(\sqrt[N^2]{\prod_{n\leq N}n^n}\right)-\log(\sqrt{N})$$求$S_N$的极限。

换一个更简单的写法，$$S_N=\frac{1}{N^2}\sum_{n\leq N} n\log(n)-\frac{1}{2}\log(N)$$

problems.statement_en:
Using the smoothness of \(x\log x\), one can obtain the asymptotic formula
\[\sum_{n\le N} n\log n=\left(\frac{N^2}{2}+\frac{N}{2}+\frac{1}{12}\right)\log N-\frac{N^2}{4}+\frac{1}{12}-\zeta'(-1)+O\!\left(\frac{1}{N}\right),\]
and hence
\[S_N=-\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{2}\frac{\log N}{N}+\frac{1}{12}\frac{\log N}{N^2}+\frac{\frac{1}{12}-\zeta'(-1)}{N^2}+O\!\left(\frac{1}{N^3}\right).\]
problems.statement_zh: 我们还可以利用$x\log(x)$的光滑性得到更精确的余项。借助这个强大的工具我们甚至可以得到下面的渐近$$\sum_{n\leq N} n\log(n)=\left(\frac{N^2}{2}+\frac{N}{2}+\frac{1}{12}\right) \log N-\frac{N^2}{4}+\frac{1}{12}-\zeta^{\prime}(-1)+O(\frac{1}{N})$$于是$$S_N=-\frac{1}{4}+\frac{1}{2}\frac{\log(N)}{N}+\frac{1}{12}\frac{\log(N)}{N^2}+\frac{\frac{1}{12}-\zeta'(-1)}{N^2}+O(\frac{1}{N^3})$$

key_techniques_discussed: Riemann-sum interpretation via the definition of the Riemann integral
termwise comparison after rewriting the constant term as a sum
